title: Smoky Quesadilla Tofu Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Asian and Mexican flavors, this quick stir-fry is made with crispy tofu and smoky quesadilla strips. Serve over steamed rice for a flavorful and nutritious meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tsp of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the sliced bell peppers and snow peas and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the torn quesadilla strips and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until crispy.
Add the pressed tofu and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Pour in the quick Chinese stir-fry sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute, until the sauce is bubbly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over steamed rice and garnish with sliced green onions, if desired.
